---
title: "House Price Estimator"
format: html
---

## 1. Generate

Generate `n` samples from distribution `family` with parameters `μ` and `σ`. The value `μt` is a true-dollar equivalent of `μ`. When `μ` is in dollars (as for Normal distribution), then `μt = μ`.

Change the parameters below and re-run the notebook.

```{r}
family <- "normal"           # "normal" or "lognormal"
mu_t <- 50                   # true value in dollars: 10 to 100
sigma <- if (family == "normal") 20 else log(20)  # normal: 10 to 100; lognormal: log(10) to log(100)
n <- 20                      # number of houses: 2 to 100
seed <- 1                    # change to regenerate the data
show_true <- TRUE            # show the true value in the plots
```

```{r}
mu_t_lim <- c(10, 100)

of_dollars <- function(x) {
  if (family == "normal") x
  else if (family == "lognormal") log(x)
  else stop("Unsupported distribution")
}

# density of the distribution with true-dollar parameter mu_t
pdf <- function(x, mu_t, sigma, log = FALSE) {
  mu <- of_dollars(mu_t)
  if (family == "normal") dnorm(x, mu, sigma, log = log)
  else if (family == "lognormal") dlnorm(x, mu, sigma, log = log)
  else stop("Unsupported distribution")
}

# n samples from the distribution with true-dollar parameter mu_t
sample_houses <- function(n, mu_t, sigma) {
  mu <- of_dollars(mu_t)
  if (family == "normal") rnorm(n, mu, sigma)
  else if (family == "lognormal") rlnorm(n, mu, sigma)
  else stop("Unsupported distribution")
}

set.seed(seed)
houses <- sample_houses(n, mu_t, sigma)
houses
```

```{r}
plot(1:n, houses, pch = 19, xlab = "House number", ylab = "Value", ylim = c(-100, 400))
if (show_true) {
  lines(c(1, n), c(mu_t, mu_t), lty = 2, lwd = 3, col = "red")
  legend("bottomright", legend = expression(mu[t]), col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 3)
}
```

## 2. Estimate parameters

Assume we know `σ` and define

- `L(μ)`: likelihood
- `ℓ(μ)`: loglikelihood

```{r}
L <- function(mu_hat_t) prod(pdf(houses, mu_hat_t, sigma))
ell <- function(mu_hat_t) sum(pdf(houses, mu_hat_t, sigma, log = TRUE))

mu_hat_t_lim <- pmax(1, (mu_t_lim - mean(mu_t_lim)) * 2 + mean(mu_t_lim))  # avoid negative dollars

mu_hat_t_opt <- if (family == "normal") mean(houses) else exp(mean(log(houses)))  # geometric mean
```

Pick an estimate `μ̂t` and see how likely the dataset is under it.

```{r}
mu_hat_t <- 40               # estimate in dollars: 1 to 145
show_opt_estimate <- FALSE   # show the maximum likelihood estimate
plot_function <- "loglik"    # "loglik" or "lik"
```

```{r}
cat("P[dataset] =", L(mu_hat_t), ", log(P[dataset]) =", ell(mu_hat_t), "\n")
```

```{r}
plot(1:n, houses, pch = 19, xlab = "House number", ylab = "Value", ylim = c(-100, 400))
if (show_true) lines(c(1, n), c(mu_t, mu_t), lty = 2, lwd = 3, col = "red")
lines(c(1, n), c(mu_hat_t, mu_hat_t), lty = 2, lwd = 3, col = "blue")
if (show_opt_estimate) lines(c(1, n), c(mu_hat_t_opt, mu_hat_t_opt), lty = 2, lwd = 3, col = "orange")
shown <- c(show_true, TRUE, show_opt_estimate)    # legend entries for the lines drawn
legend("bottomright", legend = expression(mu[t], hat(mu)[t], hat(mu)[t]^opt)[shown],
       col = c("red", "blue", "orange")[shown], lty = 2, lwd = 3)
```

```{r}
f <- if (plot_function == "lik") L else ell

x <- seq(mu_hat_t_lim[1], mu_hat_t_lim[2], length.out = 300)
plot(x, sapply(x, f), type = "l", xlab = expression("Estimated" ~ mu[t]), ylab = "(log)likelihood")
points(mu_hat_t, f(mu_hat_t), pch = 19, col = "blue")
if (show_opt_estimate) points(mu_hat_t_opt, f(mu_hat_t_opt), pch = 19, col = "orange")
shown <- c(TRUE, show_opt_estimate)
legend("bottomright", legend = expression(hat(mu)[t], hat(mu)[t]^opt)[shown], col = c("blue", "orange")[shown], pch = 19)
```
